pages.text: A route of n steps, each keeping a fraction y of the material, keeps yⁿ of it overall: steps cost. But every target has a least number of steps - the bonds that must be made one at a time - and no route is shorter.
$(thing)Set$(): Steps in the route.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Bench technique: each step keeps ±0.5%·d more or less.
$(thing)Limits$(): No route that short: the target needs more steps.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Fewer steps, quicker.
